title: Sunday Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew inspired by the traditional cuisine of Tunisia, perfect for a relaxing Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Heat the tunisian olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the sweet potato and carrots, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the poppy seeds, if using.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
